title: Aureline M5 dataset-provenance-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the dataset-provenance-card family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). A dataset provenance card names what data a run used and how completely it is provenanced so a card never severs its canonical provenance and never masks a restricted or drifted dataset. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
